messages:
deploybot: :rocket: Tagged release v1.9.5-hotpatch-20260320 pushed and rollout started. Envs: prod-eu (eu-west-1) -> prod-us (us-west-2) staggered.
deploybot: Commit/tag: v1.9.5-hotpatch-20260320, image: registry.redwood-inference/release:v1.9.5-hotpatch-20260320+sha256:7f4a2b. Change window 2026-03-20 15:00-16:00 UTC. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/scm/releases/v1.9.5-hotpatch (brief: fix tokenizer off-by-one on long prompts).
release-coordinator: noted. Canary plan: eu 2 pods (10% traffic), wait 10m, then escalate to 30% if green.
alice: starting eu canary now. applying manifest: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/generator generator=registry.redwood-inference/release:v1.9.5-hotpatch-20260320`
ben: monitor dashboards (token errors, 5xx, latency P95). I'll watch the APM traces.
alice: canary up on 2 hosts. initial health looks OK.
carol: seeing some malformed token boundaries in traces: prompts truncated differently for long multi-line prompts. sending small gif of logs.
dave_oncall: flagging — I'm seeing a spike in 502s from eu-west-1 on /v1/stream around +3m after rollout. Correlating with tokenizer errors.
alice: confirmed increased 502 rate ~12% of requests on canary hosts, latency spikes too. Holding canary, not promoting.
ben: recommend rollback for eu canary until we patch tokenizer handling. Can we undo deployment for eu?
release-coordinator: agree. We should avoid cross-region promote until root cause. Will pause us rollout.
deploybot: Received rollback request. Initiating rollback for prod-eu (eu-west-1). Command: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/generator --to-revision=3`
deploybot: Rollback in progress -> switching image back to registry.redwood-inference/release:v1.9.4+sha256:4c2d9e.
dave_oncall: rolling back now. I'll keep an eye on logs and error rates.
carol: adding repro cases and a minimal failing prompt. Pushing short test suite to the release branch.
alice: eu rollback completed, health back to baseline. 5xx rate returned to normal.
deploybot: Rollback complete for prod-eu at 2026-03-20T15:12:05Z. Canary remain paused for prod-us.
release-coordinator: good work. We'll cut a hotpatch candidate after fix, run an expanded test harness, then schedule a narrow canary with traffic shaping. Postmortem/ticket: INF-4521.
ben: filing alert runbook entry and temporary rule to block long multi-line prompts > 2048 chars for streaming endpoints until patch deployed.
dave_oncall: marking incident as mitigated. If anyone sees regressions re-open this thread. :white_check_mark:
release-coordinator: thanks all. Updated release notes with rollback summary and next steps.https://confluence.redwood/scm/releases/v1.9.5-hotpatch#rollback
